title: Add gRPC server
body:
Following the RFD and this is pretty much gRPC boilerplate wrapping the library.

[pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/) isn't really necessary, you can of course install Go and [buf](https://github.com/bufbuild/buf) however you want, but I like it a lot so am evangelizing it here 😄

title: Add the Go library
body: Add the Go worker library, following the implementation specified in the RFD.

title: Clarify that auth details do not exist at the filesystem/library level
body:
This is the source of the confusion from https://github.com/benmoss/job-worker-service/pull/1#discussion_r2670612883, it's not possible for these details to exist at the filesystem level (handled by the library) without the API of the library including some amount of user information.

Rather than this we will keep the library auth agnostic and track the mapping between users and jobs at a layer above the library.

title: Add initial RFD
body: Adds the initial design proposal for the job worker service.
